items.headline: 巴林間諜軟體案敗訴
items.context: 英國法院駁回巴林政府的聲請，讓巴林異議人士對其提起的間諜軟體訴訟得以繼續進行。這項判決確立了一個先例：只要有國家對身在英國的人使用間諜軟體，就可能在英國被告上法庭。
items.thread_text:
巴林間諜軟體案敗訴

英國法院駁回巴林政府的聲請，讓一群巴林異議人士對政府提起的間諜軟體訴訟可以繼續進行。這起判決確立了一個先例：只要有國家對身在英國的人使用間諜軟體，就可能被告上英國法院。

—— 本則來自 Reuters、Al Jazeera，2026 年 7 月 27 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
items.threads_text:
英國法院駁回巴林政府的聲請，讓一群巴林異議人士對政府提起的間諜軟體訴訟得以繼續進行。

這起案件的關鍵在於，法院認定只要有國家對身在英國境內的人使用間諜軟體監控，當事人就有權在英國法院提告。這等於替往後類似的跨國監控訴訟開了一道門。

本則整理自 Reuters 與 Al Jazeera 於 2026 年 7 月 27 日發佈的報導。
items.voice_text:
巴林政府想擋掉一起間諜軟體官司，結果敗訴了。

一群巴林的異議人士，控告巴林政府用間諜軟體監控他們，官司告到了英國法院。巴林政府想擋下這場訴訟，但被法院駁回。

這個判決等於立下先例：只要有國家對身在英國的人動用間諜軟體，就可能在英國被告上法庭。

items.headline: 屍體塑化技術發明人逝世
items.context: 德國解剖學家根特・馮・哈根斯（Gunther von Hagens）過世，享壽81歲。他發明的「塑化」技術把人體標本做成可長期展示的樣本，後來成了全球巡迴展覽《人體世界》（Body Worlds）。家屬表示，會依他生前遺願，用他自己研發的技術處理他的遺體。
items.thread_text:
屍體塑化技術發明人逝世

德國解剖學家根特・馮・哈根斯（Gunther von Hagens）過世，享壽81歲。他發明的「塑化」技術，讓人體標本能長期保存、擺出各種姿態展示，後來變成全球巡迴的《人體世界》（Body Worlds）展覽，他也因此得到「死亡博士」的稱號。家人說，會依他生前心願，用他自己發明的技術處理他的遺體。

—— 本則來自 BBC、The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 27 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
items.threads_text:
德國解剖學家根特・馮・哈根斯（Gunther von Hagens）過世，享壽81歲。

他發明的「塑化」（plastination）技術，能把人體標本做成可長期保存、擺出各種姿態的展示品，後來發展成全球巡迴的《人體世界》（Body Worlds）展覽，吸引大批觀眾，也因為爭議性十足的展示手法，讓他得到「死亡博士」的稱號。

家人表示，會依他生前的心願，用他自己發明的塑化技術處理他的遺體，讓他即使離世，也用自己開創的方式留在世界上。

本則整理自 BBC 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 27 日發佈的報導。

德國解剖學家馮・哈根斯，享壽81歲。他發明的塑化技術，能把人體標本做成可以長期保存的展示品，後來變成全球巡迴的《人體世界》展覽，讓他得到「死亡博士」的稱號。

items.context: 法國波爾多附近的野火已經燒了超過420平方公里，延燒將近四天還沒完全撲滅；西班牙馬德里周邊原本是當地史上最嚴重的野火，如今正逐漸受控。兩國都還要面對今年夏天第四波熱浪。
items.thread_text:
法國西班牙野火未歇

法國波爾多附近的野火已經燒了超過420平方公里，延燒將近四天還撲不滅；西班牙馬德里周邊的兩場大火則逐漸受控。兩地都還面臨今年夏天第四波熱浪的威脅。

—— 本則來自 NPR、BBC，2026 年 7 月 27 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
items.threads_text:
法國西南部的野火還沒撲滅。波爾多附近的一場大火，四天內燒掉超過420平方公里的土地，仍在延燒中。

同一時間，西班牙的情況稍微樂觀一點——馬德里周邊原本是該地區史上最嚴重的野火，如今兩場大火都逐漸受到控制。但兩國都還要面對今年夏天的第四波熱浪，狀況還沒真正解除。

sources.summary: Cheetahs forced to cross roiling rivers, owls battered by storms … the tone of this look at how extreme weather affects animals is all a bit disaster movie. Subtle, it is not You have a thick neck and poorly defined calf muscles and you live in South Dakota with your feckless partner and your five expressionless children. You are an owl. Your days consist of lengthy stretches of nothing, punctuated by sudden bursts of unimaginable terror. Coyotes, badgers and snakes are all bent on reducing your beak to marmalade. But it’s the weather that poses the biggest threat. Specifically, shouts Force of Nature, it’s the “MONSTER STORMS” that rumble ominously across the prairies, each of which forces you and your family to scurry into your burrow, whereupon you will stand with your trembling backs to the wall, legs wide apart and fluffy britches a-flap, like anxious viscounts in the court of Charles II. Will you survive? Or will you be eviscerated by the “ cluster bombs of tornadoes ” that churn with increasing frequency through the midwest? Continue reading...

sources.summary: Maryam Ebrahimi’s documentary about a home for survivors of the war in northern Syria is tender, gentle and incredibly moving Speaking over footage filmed at the funeral of a female army commander, documentary-maker Maryam Ebrahimi notes that it’s the first time she has seen women carrying a coffin in the Middle East. As they move through crowd of mourners, she adds: “Their sisterhood amazes me.” Ebrahimi is talking about the women of Rojava, the Kurdish-led autonomous socialist region in northern Syria. At the cemetery, the women dig the soil with their bare hands; it is a tradition in Rojava, a final act of solidarity with their fallen sister. Ebrahimi’s tender, gentle film is about a home for injured army veterans in Rojava; most are survivors of the war against Islamic State (IS). The house is mixed genders; one of the men living there is Fadakhar, who has had both his legs amputated and is haunted at night by phantom itches and pains. Mostly, though, Ebrahimi’s gaze is drawn to the female veterans, who made headlines a decade ago for their courage on the battlefield. We learn that women started leaving their villages to fight IS in 2011 – though in truth a little more background about the history of Kurdish all-female battalions might have been helpful. sources.summary: Suing his record label and sick of being a sex symbol, the singer spent 1992 working on the Trojan Souls for stars including Aretha Franklin and Bryan Ferry. Now, newly released studio footage shows him in his creative prime Wham! special: read Andrew Ridgeley on their bizarre 1985 trip to China The George Michael album that never was began in defiance and ended in grief. It was 1992. Mired in a toxic dispute with Sony Records, Michael chose to keep busy and declare his independence by making an album of songs to be sung by several of his musical heroes, including Aretha Franklin, Janet Jackson and Sade Adu, under the alias the Trojan Souls. Michael worked on the album for months until his Brazilian boyfriend Anselmo Feleppa died of Aids in March 1993 and he lost interest in music. It was never revived. Tracks from the sessions have since leaked, along with some of the fly-on-the-wall footage filmed by Michael’s close friend and informal adviser Andros Georgiou, who has spent years trying to get unauthorised clips removed from YouTube and TikTok. Now, months before the 10th anniversary of Michael’s death, he is releasing 90 minutes of unedited video as Trojan Souls – not exactly a film but an unfiltered view of Michael in his creative prime. “I thought these fans were making money from my rights so I decided to stop fighting and get it out there,” Georgiou says. He hopes it will open a door on what he calls, with characteristic hyperbole, “the greatest album never made”. Continue reading...

sources.summary: It’s set in a UK racked by an unbearable heatwave and the rise of extremism – this adaptation of the 2010 novel feels horrifyingly apt When The Rapture by Liz Jensen was first published, in 2010, it was set in a near-future when temperatures in the UK are rising to unbearable heights, culty-Christian groups with apocalyptic bents are springing up all over the place and there is a growing sense that the world is going mad. Swap out “culty-Christian” for “political extremists bent on embracing the apocalypse rather than trying to save us from it” and it would be a deluded soul indeed who wouldn’t place it among fiction’s more prescient offerings. The adaptation that has arrived on our screens 16 years later – a study in physical and mental discomfort – is the perfect accompaniment to our current record-breaking, fear-inducing heatwave, and gains a lot of power from our growing collective awareness that the future is finally here. sources.summary: The Hallmark Channel’s ropey version of The Odyssey is going viral for its star-studded cast. Christopher Nolan’s film only looks better by comparison Christopher Nolan ’s version of The Odyssey is far from the first committed to screen. As early as 1911, Italian director Guiseppe de Liguoro made a silent version entitled L’Odissea. Readers of a certain age may remember watching the futuristic animated series Ulysses 31 throughout the 1980s. O Brother, Where Art Thou? is based on The Odyssey. So too, if you squint as hard as you can and discount the Goofy Goober song, is the first SpongeBob SquarePants movie. However, the pre-Nolan adaptation that has the biggest legacy is arguably Andrei Konchalovsky’s two-part version, made in 1997 for the Hallmark Channel. This is the adaptation that has been doing the rounds in recent days, clipped up on social media (the full version is highly discoverable on YouTube) and catching the eye of Joyce Carol Oates , who spent much of Thursday night tweeting very enthusiastically about it. items.context: 美國暫停對伊朗的軍事攻擊後，國際油市信心回穩，布蘭特原油一度重挫9%，跌破每桶88美元；上週油價才因葉門青年運動（Houthis）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯油輪一度衝上每桶100美元。
items.thread_text:
美伊局勢緩和油價跌

美國暫停對伊朗的軍事攻擊後，油市信心回穩，國際油價應聲下滑。布蘭特原油一度重挫9%，跌破每桶88美元，上週才因葉門青年運動（Houthis）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯油輪，一度衝上每桶100美元。雙方自上週五起都沒有再傳出攻擊行動，投資人對局勢降溫轉趨樂觀。

導演虞戡平，拿下了今年的金馬終身成就獎。

他的代表作包括《搭錯車》和《孽子》。虞戡平說，這份榮譽剛好落在他76歲生日這天，是超級賀禮。

sources.name: 公視
sources.summary: 金馬獎執委會今（27）日宣布，本屆「終身成就獎」將頒給執導《搭錯車》、《孽子》等名作的導演虞戡平。虞戡平除感謝金馬獎肯定外，也直呼這是自己76歲生日的超級賀禮。
